name: LinformerAttention

projection_dim.description: projected sequence length for keys and values

reference:
import torch
import math
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x, n_heads, projection_dim):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    B, S, D = x.shape
    head_dim = D // n_heads
    q_proj = nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    k_proj = nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    v_proj = nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    out_proj = nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    key_reduce = nn.Linear(S, projection_dim, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    value_reduce = nn.Linear(S, projection_dim, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    q = q_proj(x).view(B, S, n_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
    k = k_proj(x).view(B, S, n_heads, head_dim).permute(0, 2, 3, 1)
    v = v_proj(x).view(B, S, n_heads, head_dim).permute(0, 2, 3, 1)
    k = key_reduce(k).transpose(-2, -1)
    v = value_reduce(v).transpose(-2, -1)
    scores = torch.matmul(q.float(), k.float().transpose(-2, -1))
    weights = F.softmax(scores / math.sqrt(head_dim), dim=-1)
    output = torch.matmul(weights, v.float()).to(dtype=x.dtype)
    output = output.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(B, S, D)
    return out_proj(output)
description: Linformer attention: projects keys and values along the sequence dimension to reduce complexity.
